blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain a tight signal for delicate fingerpicking.
Smooth out dynamics and provide a consistent, intimate tone suitable for arpeggios.

Provide a warm, clean, and articulate foundation without any noticeable grit.
Select a small, focused cabinet sound that enhances the intimate and close-mic feel.
Slightly boost the low-mids and high end to give definition to fingerpicked arpeggios without sounding bright.
Bypass the wah to maintain a natural and uncolored tone.
Avoid modulation effects as per the 'avoid' list and maintain a natural tone.
Add subtle space and depth without sounding like a rhythmic echo.

Control the overall output level to match the intimate recording style.
